001package com.streamConverter.path;
002
003import java.util.List;
004import java.util.Objects;
005import java.util.regex.Pattern;
006
007/**
008 * Type-safe representation of XPath expressions.
009 *
010 * <p>This class encapsulates XPath expressions used for navigating XML documents. It validates the
011 * path syntax at construction time and provides type safety for XML navigation operations.
012 *
013 * <p>This implementation leverages the existing FixedStaXPathHandler validation logic and supports
014 * the same XPath patterns: - Simple element paths: "root/child/grandchild" - No leading or trailing
015 * slashes - No empty segments
016 *
017 * <p>Note: This is a simplified XPath implementation focused on element navigation in
018 * StreamConverter.
019 */
020public class XPath implements IPath {
021
022  private static final String TYPE = "XPath";
023
024  // XML element name pattern for validation
025  private static final Pattern XML_ELEMENT_NAME_PATTERN =
026      Pattern.compile("^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9._-]*$");
027
028  private final String path;
029  private final List<String> pathSegments;
030
031  /**
032   * Creates a new XPath instance.
033   *
034   * @param path the XPath expression (e.g., "users/user/name")
035   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the path is null, empty, or has invalid syntax
036   */
037  public XPath(String path) {
038    if (path == null) {
039      throw new IllegalArgumentException("XPath cannot be null");
040    }
041
042    String trimmedPath = path.trim();
043    if (trimmedPath.isEmpty()) {
044      throw new IllegalArgumentException("XPath cannot be empty");
045    }
046
047    // Normalize path using the same logic as FixedStaXPathHandler
048    String normalizedPath =
049        trimmedPath
050            .replaceAll("^/+", "") // Remove leading slashes
051            .replaceAll("/+$", "") // Remove trailing slashes
052            .replaceAll("/+", "/"); // Collapse multiple slashes
053
054    if (normalizedPath.isEmpty()) {
055      throw new IllegalArgumentException("XPath cannot be just slashes");
056    }
057
058    this.path = normalizedPath;
059    this.pathSegments = List.of(normalizedPath.split("/"));
060
061    validate();
062  }
063
064  /**
065   * Factory method for creating an XPath from path segments.
066   *
067   * @param segments the path segments (e.g., "users", "user", "name")
068   * @return an XPath constructed from the segments
069   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if segments are invalid
070   */
071  public static XPath fromSegments(String... segments) {
072    if (segments == null || segments.length == 0) {
073      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Path segments cannot be null or empty");
074    }
075
076    for (String segment : segments) {
077      if (segment == null || segment.trim().isEmpty()) {
078        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Path segment cannot be null or empty");
079      }
080    }
081
082    return new XPath(String.join("/", segments));
083  }
084
085  /**
086   * Factory method for creating a single-element XPath.
087   *
088   * @param elementName the element name
089   * @return an XPath for the single element
090   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if elementName is invalid
091   */
092  public static XPath element(String elementName) {
093    if (elementName == null || elementName.trim().isEmpty()) {
094      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Element name cannot be null or empty");
095    }
096    return new XPath(elementName.trim());
097  }
098
099  @Override
100  public void validate() {
101    // Validate no empty segments remain after normalization
102    if (pathSegments.contains("")) {
103      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
104          "XPath must not contain empty segments after normalization: " + path);
105    }
106
107    // Validate each segment is a valid XML element name
108    for (String segment : pathSegments) {
109      if (!isValidXmlElementName(segment)) {
110        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid XML element name: " + segment);
111      }
112    }
113  }
114
115  @Override
116  public String getPath() {
117    return path;
118  }
119
120  @Override
121  public String getType() {
122    return TYPE;
123  }
124
125  @Override
126  public boolean isEquivalentTo(IPath other) {
127    if (!(other instanceof XPath)) {
128      return false;
129    }
130    return Objects.equals(this.path, ((XPath) other).path);
131  }
132
133  /**
134   * Returns the path segments as an immutable list.
135   *
136   * @return the path segments
137   */
138  public List<String> getSegments() {
139    return List.copyOf(pathSegments);
140  }
141
142  /**
143   * Gets the number of path segments.
144   *
145   * @return the depth of the path
146   */
147  public int getDepth() {
148    return pathSegments.size();
149  }
150
151  /**
152   * Checks if this is a single-element path.
153   *
154   * @return true if the path has only one segment
155   */
156  public boolean isSingleElement() {
157    return pathSegments.size() == 1;
158  }
159
160  /**
161   * Gets the last element in the path.
162   *
163   * @return the last element name
164   */
165  public String getLastElement() {
166    return pathSegments.get(pathSegments.size() - 1);
167  }
168
169  /**
170   * Gets the first element in the path.
171   *
172   * @return the first element name
173   */
174  public String getFirstElement() {
175    return pathSegments.get(0);
176  }
177
178  /**
179   * Creates a child XPath by appending an element.
180   *
181   * @param childElement the child element to append
182   * @return a new XPath with the child element appended
183   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if childElement is invalid
184   */
185  public XPath child(String childElement) {
186    if (childElement == null || childElement.trim().isEmpty()) {
187      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Child element cannot be null or empty");
188    }
189    return new XPath(path + "/" + childElement.trim());
190  }
191
192  private static boolean isValidXmlElementName(String elementName) {
193    if (elementName == null || elementName.isEmpty()) {
194      return false;
195    }
196
197    // Basic XML element name validation
198    // Must start with letter or underscore, followed by letters, digits, hyphens, periods, or
199    // underscores
200    return XML_ELEMENT_NAME_PATTERN.matcher(elementName).matches();
201  }
202
203  @Override
204  public String toString() {
205    return String.format("XPath('%s')", path);
206  }
207
208  @Override
209  public boolean equals(Object obj) {
210    if (this == obj) return true;
211    if (obj == null || getClass() != obj.getClass()) return false;
212    XPath xPath = (XPath) obj;
213    return Objects.equals(path, xPath.path);
214  }
215
216  @Override
217  public int hashCode() {
218    return Objects.hash(path);
219  }
220}
